from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

        star_b = Star(n=5, outer_radius=0.15, inner_radius=0.07, color=color_b, fill_opacity=1)

        star_b.move_to(pos_b)
        star_c.move_to(pos_c)

        label_a = Text("A", font_size=24, color=color_a).next_to(star_a, UR, buff=0.1)
        label_b = Text("B", font_size=24, color=color_b).next_to(star_b, DOWN, buff=0.1)
        label_c = Text("C", font_size=24, color=color_c).next_to(star_c, UL, buff=0.1)

        # Laser line split in two to visualize the swap
        # Initially horizontal through A and C
        laser_left = Line(LEFT * 4, ORIGIN, color=BLUE, stroke_width=4)
        laser_right = Line(ORIGIN, RIGHT * 4, color=RED, stroke_width=4)
        laser = VGroup(laser_left, laser_right)
        
        # Trackers for smooth animation
        pivot_tracker = ValueTracker(pos_a)
        angle_tracker = ValueTracker(PI) # Start horizontal to the left (180 deg)

        # Updater for the laser line
        def update_laser(m):
            m.set_angle(angle_tracker.get_value())
            m.move_to(pivot_tracker.get_value())
        
        laser.add_updater(update_laser)

        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(color_a),
            FadeIn(star_a), FadeIn(star_b), FadeIn(star_c),
            Write(label_a), Write(label_b), Write(label_c),
            Create(laser)
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Rotate CW from A until it hits B (Interior angle at A is 45 deg)
        # Target angle for line AB is 135 deg (3*PI/4)
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(color_b),
            angle_tracker.animate.set_value(135 * DEGREES),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=linear
        )
        # Transition pivot to B
        pivot_tracker.set_value(pos_b)
        self.play(Indicate(star_b, color=color_b))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Rotate CW from B until it hits C (Interior angle at B is 90 deg)
        # Target angle for line BC is 45 deg (PI/4)
        self.play(
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(color_c),
            angle_tracker.animate.set_value(45 * DEGREES),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=linear
        )
        # Transition pivot to C
        pivot_tracker.set_value(pos_c)
        self.play(Indicate(star_c, color=color_c))
        self.wait(1)

        # Rotate CW from C until it hits A (Interior angle at C is 45 deg)
        # Target angle for line CA is 0 deg (returns to horizontal)
        self.play(
            self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(color_line),
            angle_tracker.animate.set_value(0 * DEGREES),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=linear
        )
        # Transition pivot back to A at the 180 degree mark
        pivot_tracker.set_value(pos_a)
        
        # Show pivot path (triangle ABC)
        triangle_path = DashedLine(pos_a, pos_b, color="#555555").add_line_to(pos_c).add_line_to(pos_a)
        self.play(Create(triangle_path))
        self.play(Indicate(star_a, color=color_a))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # Highlight that Blue was on the left and is now on the right
        # Sides have swapped
        side_swap_arrow = DoubleArrow(pos_a + UP*0.5 + LEFT*2, pos_a + UP*0.5 + RIGHT*2, color=color_swap, tip_length=0.2)
        swap_text = Text("Sides Swapped", font_size=20, color=color_swap).next_to(side_swap_arrow, UP)

        self.play(
            self.lecture[4].animate.set_color(color_swap),
            Create(side_swap_arrow),
            Write(swap_text)
        )
        
        # Final rotation to emphasize the flip
        self.play(Indicate(laser_left), Indicate(laser_right))
        self.wait(3)
